claims.text: arXiv announced terms.txt at exactly 2026-09-12T04:00:00Z.
claims.sourceLocator: RSS item pubDate and guid

claims.text: The public work is a single-author arXiv v1 preprint and its software labels itself v0.1.
claims.sourceLocator: s2 header; s3 Status and release

claims.text: The proposal joins a per-path and per-purpose terms file, Web Bot Auth signatures, signed intent, optional delegation and payment, and signed receipts at an origin.
claims.sourceLocator: s2 abstract and Sections V-VI; s3 The file and The exchange

claims.text: The file can describe unsigned handling and allow, charge or deny decisions by purpose, with use, price and delegation scope.
claims.sourceLocator: s2 Section V example and parser description; s3 The file

claims.text: The proposed exchange returns served content and a receipt, HTTP 402 for payment, 401 for identity failures or 403 for refusal.
claims.sourceLocator: s2 Section V; s3 The exchange

claims.text: A signature makes identity and a declared intent attributable, but does not prove intent truth or govern later use of delivered content.
claims.sourceLocator: s2 Sections VI and VIII; s4 Sections 4.1 and 4.6

claims.text: The repository contains a dependency-free Node.js prototype, 24 checks, raw results and a local resolver; grammar, delegation and receipt formats remain open.
claims.sourceLocator: Files, Running and Status

claims.sourceLocator: Sections 1 and 3

claims.sourceLocator: s6 status and Sections 3-4; s7 status and Sections 1-3

claims.text: AIPREF does not ensure preferences are followed or decide the legal, technical or contractual compliance mechanism.
claims.sourceLocator: Section 3.2

claims.text: Web Bot Auth draft 00 uses HTTP Message Signatures and HTTPS key discovery so a verifier can associate a signed request with a published key and URL.
claims.sourceLocator: Abstract and Sections 4.1, 5.2 and 5.5
